inspectedText: Chimney fire smouldered under the Lords floor following burning of two cartloads of obsolete receipts in heating furnaces. Warnings ignored; flames emerged through floor after six. Vulnerable sprawling building and firefighting conditions mattered. Westminster Hall was protected and survived.
